zh.title: B-2017 號 B734 航機觀測抵達桃園機場
zh.summary: 註冊號 B-2017 的 B734 航機；呼號 CSS266；確認抵達桃園機場
body: 本站監測系統觀測到一架航空器抵達臺灣桃園國際機場（TPE）。依據公開 ADS-B 觀測資料，該航機的註冊號為 B-2017，航空器 ICAO hex 為 7809f0，機型顯示名稱為 B734，呼號為 CSS266。營運者 ICAO 為 CSS，但營運者 IATA、營運者名稱、營運者中文名稱及營運者所屬國家或地區均顯示為未識別。
觀測紀錄顯示，首次有效觀測時間為 2026-08-11T23:56:26Z，確認抵達時間為 2026-08-12T01:10:29Z。抵達判定為 confirmed_arrival，確認依據為位於機場地理圍欄內且 alt_baro 為 ground。有效觀測筆數為 2 筆。
本次觀測的主要資料來源為 Airplanes.live，第二資料來源為 ADSB.lol。交叉確認狀態為 secondary_unavailable，表示第二資料來源在本次觀測期間無法提供交叉比對資料。機場 ICAO 代碼為 RCTP，機場名稱為臺灣桃園國際機場。
統計說明欄位指出，系統觀測歷史累積中，尚無可比較的長期統計。因此本次觀測組合在本站系統中缺乏長期比較基準，不宜與歷史紀錄進行頻率或稀有度之推論。事件 ID 為 fw-7b04d5d22c1eab80。
由於營運者 IATA、營運者名稱、營運者中文名稱及營運者所屬國家或地區均標示為未識別，本站無法自觀測資料確認該航機所屬航空公司或其國別歸屬。呼號 CSS266 中的 CSS 碼對應營運者 ICAO 欄位，但觀測資料本身未提供進一步的營運者識別資訊。本報導僅依據觀測資料記錄此抵達事件，不對航機用途、航線、包機安排或營運者身分進行推測。

en.title: B-2017 B734 Aircraft Observed Arriving at Taoyuan International Airport
en.summary: Registration B-2017 B734; callsign CSS266; confirmed arrival at Taoyuan
body: The site's monitoring system observed an aircraft arriving at Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport (TPE). According to public ADS-B observation data, the aircraft bore registration B-2017, with ICAO hex 7809f0, aircraft type display name B734, and callsign CSS266. The operator ICAO is CSS, while operator IATA, operator name, operator Chinese name, and operator country or region are all listed as unidentified.

The observation record shows a first valid observation time of 2026-08-11T23:56:26Z and a confirmed arrival time of 2026-08-12T01:10:29Z. The arrival determination is confirmed_arrival, with the confirmation basis being that the aircraft was located within the airport geofence and alt_baro indicated ground level. The number of valid observation records is 2.

The primary data source for this observation is Airplanes.live, with a secondary data source of ADSB.lol. The cross-confirmation status is secondary_unavailable, indicating that the secondary data source could not provide cross-referencing data during this observation period. The airport ICAO code is RCTP, and the airport name is Taiwan Taoyuan International Airport.

The statistics note states that the system's observation history is still accumulating, with no comparable long-term statistics available. Consequently, this observation combination lacks a long-term comparison baseline within the site's system, and no frequency or rarity inference should be drawn against historical records. The event ID is fw-7b04d5d22c1eab80.

Because operator IATA, operator name, operator Chinese name, and operator country or region are all marked as unidentified, the site cannot confirm from the observation data which airline operates this aircraft or its national affiliation. The CSS code in callsign CSS266 corresponds to the operator ICAO field, but the observation data itself provides no further operator identification. This report records the arrival event based solely on observation data and does not speculate on the aircraft's purpose, route, charter arrangements, or operator identity.
